This ensures the 19 edge requirement.

# Check number of vertices
vertices = set()
for u, v in edges:
    vertices.add(u)
    vertices.add(v)
print(f"Number of vertices: {len(vertices)}")

# Check number of edges
print(f"Number of edges: {len(edges)}")

# Check if bipartite (2-colorable)
import networkx as nx
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(15))
G.add_edges_from(edges)
print(f"Is bipartite: {nx.is_bipartite(G)}")

# Check girth
try:
    girth = nx.girth(G)
    print(f"Girth: {girth}")
except:
    # If girth function is not available, check for triangles
    triangles = [c for c in nx.enumerate_all_cliques(G) if len(c) == 3]
    print(f"Triangles: {triangles}")
    print(f"Girth >= 4: {len(triangles) == 0}")
